channels.name: given_name
channels.definition: Characters of a person_name span that constitute the given name. The name's written order does not change this predicate.

channels.name: family_name
channels.definition: Characters of a person_name span that constitute the family name or surname.

channels.name: care_provider
channels.definition: The person mention identifies a clinician, nurse, treating professional, or other care-giving role holder rather than a patient, relative, witness, bystander, or unrelated person.

target_encoding.token_rule: A token is positive iff it overlaps a positive character extent. Other tokens inside the same explicitly labeled activating span are known negative. Every token outside such a span is unknown.
